folds.rule: min(5, U // 3) folds of numpy default_rng(fold_seed).permutation of the sorted string labels (plan §3); passed to beat_audit as explicit Population folds, so a user excluded from a cell leaves the others' folds unchanged

sampling_seeds.derived: beat_audit.engine: comparator, pair-training and closed-set seed = seed + 1009 x fold + 101 x model-seed index; comparison and gallery draws = that seed + 37 x pair + 17 x direction; matching permutations = seed; subject bootstrap and contrasts = seed + 1

not_run_by_design: rich-summary comparators at k = 1 (plan §3: the rich summary equals the mean there; the tool skips them)

V1.test: mean per-user AUC > 0.5, matching permutation test

selection.rule: highest Lee2019 cross-day mean per-user AUC on full features (P0) at k = 20 over the feature comparators that survive the runtime gate; an exact tie goes to the simpler comparator in the order cosine, LDA + WCCN, cosine (rich summary), LDA + WCCN (rich summary), pairwise logistic

V2.test: mean per-user AUC > 0.5, matching permutation test
